The *Cittasahabhūduka* is a dyad (*duka*) section within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. As with other dyadic chapters in the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the conditional relation matrix to dhammas that arise together with consciousness (*cittasahabhū*) and those that do not.
